Both targets are known to be involved in the control of the cell cycle, particularly in the M-phase, and their regulation is linked to the phosphorylation of M-phase phosphoprotein 8. The evidence is supported by a moderate confidence score, indicating that the compound may have a functional role in modulating the activity of these targets, which in turn influence the phosphorylation of M-phase phosphoprotein 8.
